#!name=驾考宝典
#!author=queitstart pro
#!date=2026-11-21
#!format=sgmodule


[URL Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/\w+\.kakamobi\.cn\/api\/open\/v\d\/advert-sdk\//i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/789\.kakamobi\.cn\/.+adver/i then reject_img(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/smart\.789\.image\.mucang\.cn\/advert/i then reject_img(200)

[Map Local]
^https:\/\/scs\.kakamobi\.cn\/api\/open\/v3\/advert-sdk\/ data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"
^https:\/\/cheyouquan\.kakamobi\.com\/api\/open\/group\/recommend-subscribe-tag\.htm data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"
^https:\/\/swallow\.kakamobi\.cn\/api\/open\/config\/get-config\.htm data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"
^https:\/\/monkey\.kakamobi\.cn\/api\/open\/live\/get-recommend-live-protocol\.htm data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"
^https:\/\/jiaxiao-awd\.kakamobi\.cn\/api\/h5\/v4\/home-lead-advertise\/abtest\.htm data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"
^https:\/\/mcbd\.maiche\.com\/api\/open\/v3\/user\/get-popup-window\.htm data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"
^https:\/\/jiakao-misc\.kakamobi\.cn\/api\/open\/my-tab-config\/selection-list\.htm data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"
^https:\/\/jiakao-misc\.kakamobi\.cn\/api\/open\/my-tab-config\/banner-list\.htm data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"
^https:\/\/squirrel\.kakamobi\.cn\/api\/open\/recommend-goods\/get-my-page-banner\.htm data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"
^https:\/\/mcbd\.maiche\.com\/api\/open\/v2\/jiakao-business\/get-naben-advert\.htm data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"
^https:\/\/monkey\.kakamobi\.cn\/api\/open\/live-room\/get-resource\.htm data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"

[MITM]
hostname = %APPEND% *.kakamobi.cn, smart.789.image.mucang.cn, jiaxiao-awd.kakamobi.cn, cheyouquan.kakamobi.com, swallow.kakamobi.cn, monkey.kakamobi.cn, mcbd.maiche.com, jiakao-misc.kakamobi.cn, squirrel.kakamobi.cn, scs.kakamobi.cn
